description: PYPOWER, published by rwl, solves AC and DC power-flow and optimal-power-flow problems as a Python port of MATPOWER. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: Numerical correctness and compatibility have not been independently tested. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support network flow, optimisation studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: model-matpower is the upstream MATLAB implementation; this is the separately distributed Python port.
